answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide to getting **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Trial (In-Car)**
SiriusXM offers a free 3-month trial subscription that gives you every channel, including every premium channel, plus access inside and outside the car and on the app.

- The car satellite radio option will ask for your VIN, but that's it.
- This offer is available only on qualifying inactive radios as determined solely by SiriusXM.

---

### 2. **SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial (App/Online)**
SiriusXM also offers 3 months free of SiriusXM Streaming (a $29.97 value). While the in-car offer gives you satellite radio in your car, the streaming offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.

- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months are over.
- Both offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels, plus access to live sports – including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports – plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 3. **New Car Free Trial**
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time.

Every manufacturer currently offers a radio with SiriusXM built into its capabilities.

---

### 4. **Periodic Free Listen Events**
SiriusXM sometimes offers completely free listening periods — for example, they ran a free listen event from May 21 – June 1, where you could listen to great music, sports analysis, comedy and more. Keep an eye on SiriusXM.com for future free listen events.

---

### 5. **Warranty/Service Contract Trial**
A 3-month SiriusXM Platinum Plan trial subscription is also available with purchase of a Warranty Vehicle Service Contract on eligible vehicles with a factory-installed satellite radio, giving you access to SiriusXM's best package, including all premium programming with access in the car and on the SiriusXM app.

---

## 💡 Why Bother with Satellite Radio?
There are many places in the country where streaming services just don't work — you're depending on a signal on your phone or through onboard WiFi. If you're out in the middle of nowhere, you'll be disappointed if you rely solely on streaming. With SiriusXM, you can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same channel from coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite-based and the whole country is covered.

---

### 🔗 Where to Sign Up:
- **In-Car Trial:** [siriusxm.com/trial-eligibility](https://www.siriusxm.com/trial-eligibility)
- **Streaming Trial:** [siriusxm.com/free-trial](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial)
